parent_objective: implement trajectory and terminal-margin sensitive source miner

public_gates: miner writes summary candidate perturbation accepted source split and rejected artifacts
normal-failed rows are rejected from action-critical acceptance
terminal-margin and risk sensitivity metrics are reported
no actor update PPO or promotion occurs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not accept output-only exact residual metrics as source evidence
do not accept already normal-failed rows as action-critical

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_source: closed-loop terminal-margin sensitivity and history/action criticality
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements the first post-pivot source miner and classifies whether a trajectory-sensitive source exists
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: source-mining result only, not objective training or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop before objective design unless result_class is source_positive
stop and audit if accepted_rows is zero
stop if all sensitive rows are already normal-failed
fallback_plan: if source_sparse, broaden scenario sampling before objective design
if normal_failed_only, improve base driver capability before self-ID proof
if history_insensitive, separate base trajectory-boundary training from self-ID evidence
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: after M695 result if source is empty sparse or normal-failed-only

hypothesis: Closed-loop perturbation replay can identify terminal-margin-sensitive rows that are not already normal-failed and are diverse enough to support a later objective.
success_criteria: no actor update PPO or promotion
failure_criteria: implementation trains or mutates the actor
implementation accepts normal-failed rows as action-critical
implementation admits objective training without source_positive result
decision_rule: M695 passes as implementation if it writes complete mining artifacts without actor mutation; only result_class=source_positive can admit objective design.
